arjun: Heads-up: during an onboarding session the speech-sample README tripped the new engineer. A couple of copy/paste issues.
paula: what did you see?
arjun: First the curl snippet uses OLD_ENV_KEY and posts to https://api.redwood.ai/v0/stream (404). Second, the README shows a JS example with `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` while our packaged name is `@redwood-inference/sdk`.
denise: that's been a persistent drift vector. Also noticed the README had an example that mixes CommonJS and ESM: `const { Redwood } = require('@redwood-inference/sdk')` but the sample's package.json is now "type":"module" and the starter uses `import` — confusing for new hires.
paula: ugh. Did the README also mention retry parity?
arjun: yes — it says "retry defaults align with Python" which is not true. JS client uses jittered exponential backoff by default; Python has a different default. I suggest we avoid asserting parity and instead add a short line like: "Retry defaults vary by SDK; see /docs/retries.md for details."
denise: agreed. For a quick patch we should: (1) update curl env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY and correct base URL to api.redwood-inference.com, (2) fix imports to `@redwood-inference/sdk` and normalize code blocks to ESM, (3) add a short retry note, (4) replace node-fetch with undici in sample package.json and ensure "type":"module" is set.
paula: please open a PR. Also can we add a GH code block for the import so it highlights properly? e.g.:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```
arjun: will do. I'll also add a Troubleshooting section that says: "If you get 401, check REDWOOD_API_KEY and region endpoint (see /docs/regions.md)."
paula: another small win: add a non-blocking samples-smoke job to samples CI that runs `npm ci && node examples/speech/index.mjs` to catch ESM/node-fetch breakages.
denise: good idea. Also add a CONTRIBUTING.md checklist item: "When changing SDK or API surfaces, update sample READMEs: imports, env names, and run local smoke test."
arjun: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/5412 title: "fix(samples): normalize ESM imports, update curl/env, clarify retry defaults + CI smoke"
docs-bot: PR opened by arjun: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/5412 :rocket:
ci-bot: link-checker: broken README link detected -> ./examples/speech/stream.mjs (reported 2026-06-10T09:12:07Z)
paula: nice catch. If you can also run a grep across samples for `@redwood/inference` we can quickly sweep remaining drift.
arjun: added that to the PR description and ran a quick fix commit for two more READMEs.
denise: leaving retry parity for eng-docs to handle in Q3 (we filed issue #1123). For now the README change avoids claiming parity and links to the retries doc.
paula: thanks team. i'll merge after CI is green. small tidy but high impact for onboarding. :white_check_mark:
